title: Nutty Crispy Uruguayan Beef Tagine
description: A peppery and crispy Uruguayan dish featuring pecan nuts and rest meat, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and cooked in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef brisket pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped pecan nuts, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt, and stir to combine.
Pour in the beef broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the tagine with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
